other_conditions: Patient must possess a National Food Security Card
Treatment must be received at a Government Hospital in Delhi
Applicant must provide domicile proof of continuous residence in Delhi for the last 3 years
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of up to ₹1.5 lakh for treatment of diseases in Delhi government hospitals for patients holding a National Food Security Card.
documents_required: Domicile proof (continuous residence in Delhi for last 3 years)
